title: Alarms Split From Content Feed: 6 Alerts Get Own Bot | vitalii.no
description:
My main Telegram bot was where I read news cards with approve or reject buttons and watched voice-blog previews — but it was also where every token-expiry alarm, feature-discovery report, rewrite-stats summary and digest-watchdog notice landed. A day with three or four infrastructure pings buried the actual content I was supposed to act on.

Six places that send Telegram messages now read a separate tech bot token and chat id first, falling back to the original content bot only if those aren't set: the LinkedIn-token checker, feature discovery, feature social publishing, rewrite stats, the daily social picker, and two VPS shell scripts (the YouTube upload queue and the digest watchdog). Setting just two secrets is enough to split all six away from the content feed.

Leave the new secrets unset and every report lands exactly where it did before — nothing breaks, it just keeps the old behavior. Set them, and the content chat only ever carries content again.
